Dr. Denis Anikiev delivered an invited technical presentation to the Microseismic User Group of the Canadian Society of Exploration Geophysicists titled *Machine Learning and Generative AI for Microseismicity: Toward Intelligent, Adaptive, and Interpretable Passive Seismic Workflows*.

The presentation reviewed how supervised and unsupervised learning, physics-informed models, neural operators, and generative diffusion methods can support the detection, reconstruction, and localization of weak microseismic signals. It also discussed the role of explainable-AI methods such as Grad-CAM and SHAP in evaluating model behavior.

The talk outlined a path toward passive-seismic workflows that combine data-driven performance with physical constraints and interpretable results.
